scene: The open hatch reveals a bustling underground transit hub humming with curious vehicles.
picture: A wide subterranean station along one stone platform. On the far left, a red double-decker bus idles by a sign for Comic Book Lane. Left of centre, the dark-haired boy stands with his skateboard. Up high in the centre hangs an open rope lift. On the right waits a bright yellow skate-park shuttle.
shown: a bright red double-decker bus waiting with open doors on the far left
a wooden rope-bridge lift basket swinging empty, suspended up high in the centre
a sleek yellow skate-park shuttle idling with glowing wheel ramps on the right
